gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients must have Grade 4 isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) wild type GBM with local pathology confirmed MGMT-promoter unmethylated status.

candidate_evidence.quote: The study is designed as an open label, multi-center, Phase 1 study of single agent tinostamustine, used as adjuvant treatment in patients with newly diagnosed GBM who are MGMT unmethylated and have completed concomitant treatment with temozolomide and radiation.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: as Adjuvant Treatment in Patients With Newly Diagnosed Unmethylated MGMT-promoter Glioblastoma

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Pharmacokinetic assessment: plasma concentrations of tinostamustine

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational alkylating agent / HDAC inhibitor fusion molecule (bendamustine-vorinostat hybrid, EDO-S101)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: a Novel Alkylating and Deacetylase Inhibiting Molecule

source_quote.quote: Patients must have Grade 4 isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) wild type GBM with local pathology confirmed MGMT-promoter unmethylated status.
Confirmed IDH wild type. The presence of an IDH mutation will be exclusionary for study enrolment.

coder_notes: Early Phase 1 (translational subset). Temozolomide + radiotherapy completed before entry and not given on study (single-agent tinostamustine replaces adjuvant TMZ), so temozolomide not listed as an agent; regimen monotherapy. MGMT-unmethylated eligibility not candidate-matched (tinostamustine is not an MGMT-targeting agent), although the rationale for an alkylator in MGMT-unmethylated tumours could be raised by an adjudicator. PK is plasma-only. Valproate is an exclusion (HDAC activity), not an agent.
